notes: All five types on the floor at ten rotations and on walls at the four facings (te_skulls). The renderer disables GL_CULL_FACE and enables GL_RESCALE_NORMAL without restoring either, so the dispatcher threads both into the tile entities after it, as vanilla leaves them.
